## IDiceBlock type

Dice block configuration for Telegram dice animations.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IDiceBlock = {
    emoji: string;
};
```

## Remarks

Declared with `<g-dice>` blocks. `emoji` supports the same `{{var|filter}}` interpolation pipeline as poll questions and defaults to `🎲` when the attribute is absent; the compiled value is checked at runtime by `Ctx.assertDiceEmoji` before any API call.

## Example


```typescript
const dice: IDiceBlock = {
  emoji: `🎯`
}
```
